parameters:
"After defeating the mud youkai... we
encountered an unknown youkai near the
Shirosha."
list._original:
「泥の怪異討伐後のこと……
　摂社近辺にて未知の怪異と遭遇」

parameters:
"We engaged in battle but were injured and
forced to retreat to regroup. It ignored the
enemy in front of it and targeted those in the
rear. We were caught off guard."
list._original:
「交戦するも負傷し、立て直すべく撤退した。
　奴は目の前の相手を無視し、後方にいる者を狙う。
　不意を突かれてしまった」
